featured_reviews.name: Sujit jha
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very Bad Experience | Worst Cloth Shop in Nalasopara West
I had a very bad experience at this family cloth shop in Nalasopara West while purchasing a school uniform. The dress provided was undersized and not as per the measurements given, yet the staff tried to manipulate and insist that the size was correct, which was completely unacceptable.
The staff behavior was extremely rude and arrogant. Statements like “Nahi lena hai mat lo, paisa wapas le lo” show their lack of professionalism and respect for customers. Such language is not expected, especially when parents are buying school uniforms for their children.
This shop is highly unreliable for school uniforms. I sincerely request school authorities not to provide or assign any uniform orders to this shop, as both their staff and management are irresponsible and unethical.
I also strongly advise parents not to buy clothes from this shop, where customer requirements are ignored and unethical business practices are followed.
Ratings:
Customer Handling: 1/10
On-time Order Delivery: 1/10
Quality of Clothes: 1/10
Staff Knowledge: 1/10
Overall, a worst experience. Not recommended at all.

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
Very poor experience at Intune store.
The entire store had “Buy 2 Get 2” offer signage displayed everywhere, which was extremely misleading. When I selected items from the section where the offer was mentioned, at the billing counter I was told that only 2 out of the 4 items were actually under the offer and the remaining 2 were “fresh pieces” and not eligible.
I then went back and picked another 2 items from the offer section. However, when I returned to billing, the staff member—who had earlier confirmed that the initial items were part of the offer—suddenly said those were also not included. He himself was confused and unsure about the offer, asked me to wait, and wasted almost an hour of my time.
The store manager was not responding to calls initially. After a long wait, when he finally arrived, he admitted that it was a mistake and that the initial items were not part of the offer either. Overall, it was a complete mess. The staff is clearly not aware of the offers, and random offer boards are placed all over the store without any clarity.
Very poor service and a frustrating experience. This was my first visit and will definitely be my last. Would not recommend this store to anyone.
